eyebrow: Morris fragrance & personal care by Aroma Prima Livindo

highlights.title: Morris Eau de Parfum
highlights.body: Morris is positioned as an everyday fragrance line designed around freshness, confidence and broad scent choices.

highlights.title: Large fragrance portfolio
highlights.body: Aroma Prima Livindo maintains an extensive Eau de Parfum catalogue across gourmand, floral, fantasy, travel and other editions.

highlights.title: Tangerang manufacturing
highlights.body: The company lists its manufacturing facility in the Balaraja industrial area, Tangerang, Indonesia.

highlights.title: Multi-format personal care
highlights.body: Beyond Eau de Parfum, the portfolio extends into deodorant, men’s care and other fragrance-led personal care products.
